The theorem takes an actual completed middle prefix and its continuation at the existing last barrier. The concurrent fragment ends after arithmetic; index/store/return use the separate fetched model. Automatic whole-run segmentation, concurrent tail interleaving, prologue/gather and full admission remain explicit obligations.
